==Acquisition==
'''[[Signet of Capture]]'''
*[[Eye of the North]]
**[[Fureyst Sharpsight]] ([[Sacnoth Valley]]) (requires a party member to be carrying a [[Proof of Triumph]])

Note that as a [[List of PvE-only skills|PvE-only]] skill, [[Elite Skill Tome|Elite Skill Tomes]] cannot be used to learn this skill.

==Notes==
*This is a [[core]] skill, but [[Guild Wars Eye of the North]] is required to obtain the skill.
*Party members only need to be nearby the Ranger or the pet for the initial application of the skill; once it is acquired, they may leave nearby range without losing its effect.
*The player does not need an active pet to use this skill.
{{anomaly|The description omits to mention that all pets in the party are affected as well.}} 
{{anomaly|The concise description omits that the additional damage only applies to attacks.}} 
{{bug|The actual range is [[in the area]].}}

==Trivia==
*This skill icon is an altered version of the [[gw2:ranger|ranger]] elite command [[gw2:Strength of the Pack|"Strength of the Pack!"]] from ''[[Guild Wars 2]]'', which grants additional damage to the player and the pet. It also provides area of effect regeneration around the player with the proper traits.
*Added to the game with the [[Feedback:Game updates/20200422|22nd April 2020 update]] as part of the 15th [[Anniversary Celebration]].
[[Category:Anniversary Celebration elite skills]]
*This skill's name may be a reference to the [[w:Inheritance Cycle|Inheritance Cycle]] where the main character and several Dragonriders use the term "Together as one!" while fighting alongside their dragon partner.
